info.title: Birdeye Data Services APIs
info.description:
To utilize the Birdeye Data Services APIs, an API key is required for authentication. You can obtain an API key by signing up for a bds.birdeye.so account and generating an API key in your account settings. Include this API key in the headers of your API requests for authentication.

Here's a step-by-step guide on how to obtain an API key: [Birdeye Data Services Authentication and API Keys](https://docs.birdeye.so/docs/authentication-api-keys)

get.description: Get market data of single token
Get trade data of single token
Get top traders of given token.
The API provides detailed information top gainers/losers

401.description: Unauthorized. API key is missing or invalid

403.description: Forbidden. Request is blacklisted or not whitelisted

429.description: Too Many Requests. Rate limit reached

DefiTokenOverview.description: JSON object containing overview information of a token

DefiTokenMarketDataSingle.description: JSON object containing market data of a specific token

DefiTokenTradeDataSingle.description: JSON object containing trade data of a specific token

DefiTokenTopTraded.description: JSON object containing a list of top traded tokens

TraderGainerLoserList.description: JSON object containing a list of top gainer loser traders

walletApiBeforeParam.description: A transaction hash to traverse starting from. Only works with Solana
